entities.summary: The Broad Wall is an ancient defensive wall, located in the Jewish Quarter of Jerusalem's Old City. The wall was unearthed in the 1970s by Israeli archaeologist Nahman Avigad. Originally dated to the reign of King Hezekiah, it has been attributed in 2024, based on carbon-dating, to the reign of King Uzziah, several decades earlier.
